item.title: Arsenal earns £198.1 million as Premier League distributes record £3.14bn to clubs
item.dc:creator: Timothy Dehinbo
item.description:
Arsenal's first Premier League title in 22 years has earned the club £198.1 million in central payments, as distributions to England's top-flight clubs exceeded £3 billion for the first time in the 2025/26 season.

item.title: Coronation Insurance advances court-sanction scheme at ₦2.88 per share
item.dc:creator: NM Partners
item.description:
Coronation Insurance Plc announces progress towards implementing its Scheme of Arrangement following SEC approval and Federal High Court sanction. The Final Scheme Consideration is ₦2.88 per share, representing a 336.4% increase over the ₦0.66 offer proposed in 2021 and a 269.2% increase over the ₦0.78 consideration in 2023. item.title: Nigeria’s registered voters drop to 100 million as INEC removes 1.6 million invalid records
item.dc:creator: Samuel Daniel
item.description:
The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) says its national voter register now contains 100 million verified voters after removing more than 1.6 million invalid, duplicate and deceased records ahead of the January 2027 general election.

The post Nigeria’s registered voters drop to 100 million as INEC removes 1.6 million invalid records appeared first on Nairametrics.

item.title: Interbank dollar transactions rebound 328% as naira drops to N1,397/$, lowest since March 6
item.dc:creator: Kelechi Mgboji
item.description:
Interbank foreign exchange turnover rebounded by 327.7% to $702.63 million on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, as the naira weakened further to N1,397/$ at the close of trading, its weakest closing level since March 6.
